head: import { Context } from 'vibelang/context'; import { Layer } from 'vibelang/provider'; abstract class C extends Context { abstract n(): number } abstract class D extends Context { abstract n(): number } const resource = { get value(): number { return C.context().n() } }; class Resource { get value(): number { return C.context().n() } }

cases.name: getter data annotation
cases.body: const slot: { readonly value: number } = resource;

cases.name: contextual getter data annotation
cases.body: const slot: { value: number } = { get value() { return C.context().n() } };

cases.name: setter data annotation
cases.body: const slot: { value: number } = { set value(n: number) { C.context().n() } };

cases.name: class getter data annotation
cases.body: const slot: { readonly value: number } = new Resource();

cases.name: own getter behind prototype view
cases.body: const slot: Resource = resource;

cases.name: different getter capability
cases.body: const slot: typeof resource = { get value() { return D.context().n() } };

cases.name: getter row cannot cover setter row
cases.body: const slot: typeof resource = { get value() { return C.context().n() }, set value(n: number) { D.context().n() } };

cases.name: getter return annotation
cases.body: function make(): { value: number } { return resource }

cases.name: getter argument
cases.body: function read(value: { value: number }) { return value.value } function main() { return read(resource) }

cases.name: getter assignment
cases.body: let slot = { value: 0 }; slot = resource;

cases.name: getter assertion
cases.body: const slot = resource as { value: number };

cases.name: getter satisfies
cases.body: const slot = resource satisfies { value: number };

cases.name: nested getter annotation
cases.body: const slot: { nested: { value: number } } = { nested: resource };

cases.name: getter array annotation
cases.body: const slot: { value: number }[] = [resource];

cases.name: getter dictionary annotation
cases.body: const slot: Record<string, number> = resource;

cases.name: prototype getter dictionary assertion
cases.body: const slot = new Resource() as Record<string, number>;

cases.name: hidden enumerable getter
cases.body: const source = { plain: 0, get hidden() { return C.context().n() } }; const slot: { plain: number } = source;

cases.name: getter constrained generic
cases.body: function read<T extends { value: number }>(value: T) { return value.value } function main() { return read(resource) }

cases.name: nested getter constrained generic
cases.body: function read<T extends { value: number }>(value: { nested: T }) { return value.nested.value } function main() { return read({ nested: resource }) }

cases.name: generic argument mismatch is reported once
cases.body: function take<T>(body: () => number, value: T): T { return value } function main() { return take(() => C.context().n(), 0) }

cases.name: generic getter return erasure
cases.body: function erase<T extends typeof resource>(value: T): { value: number } { return value }

cases.name: generic transfer cannot widen getter to object
cases.body: function erase<T extends object>(value: T): object { return value } function main() { return erase(resource) }

cases.name: generic transfer cannot cast getter to data
cases.body: function erase<T>(value: T) { return value as { value: number } } function main() { return erase(resource) }

cases.name: generic copy hides enumerable getter
cases.body: function copy<T>(value: T) { return { ...value } } function main() { return copy(resource) }

cases.name: nested generic copy hides enumerable getter
cases.body: function copy<T>(value: { nested: T }) { return { ...value.nested } } function main() { return copy({ nested: resource }) }

cases.name: getter inferred alias
cases.body: const slot = resource; function read() { return slot.value }

cases.name: getter typeof annotation
cases.body: const slot: typeof resource = resource; function read() { return slot.value }

cases.name: getter mapped annotation
cases.body: const slot: Pick<typeof resource, 'value'> = resource; function read() { return slot.value }

cases.name: prototype may widen to own getter view
cases.body: const slot: typeof resource = new Resource(); function read() { return slot.value }

cases.name: pure data may widen to getter view
cases.body: const slot: typeof resource = { value: 1 }; function read() { return slot.value }

cases.name: pure getter data annotation
cases.body: const slot: { value: number } = { get value() { return 1 } };

cases.name: generic identity preserves getter
cases.body: function identity<T>(value: T): T { return value } const slot = identity(resource); function read() { return slot.value }

cases.name: constrained generic identity preserves getter
cases.body: function identity<T extends object>(value: T): T { return value } const slot = identity(resource); function read() { return slot.value }

cases.name: generic copy accepts plain data
cases.body: function copy<T>(value: T) { return { ...value } } const slot = copy({ value: 1 });

cases.name: generic Result callback ownership remains guarded
cases.body: function invoke<T>(body: () => T): T { return body() } function work(): Result<number, never> { return 1 } function main() { return invoke(work).getOrElse(() => 0) }

cases.name: generic Promise callback ownership remains guarded
cases.body: function invoke<T>(body: () => T): T { return body() } async function work(): Promise<number> { return 1 } async function main() { return await invoke(work) }

cases.name: provided getter materializes data
cases.body: const slot: { value: number } = Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(C, { n: () => 7 }), () => ({ ...resource }));

cases.name: key enumeration does not read getter
cases.body: const keys = Object.keys(resource);

published.source: import { Context } from 'vibelang/context'; import { Layer } from 'vibelang/provider'; export abstract class C extends Context { abstract n(): number } export const resource = { get value(): number { return C.context().n() } }; export class Resource { get value(): number { return C.context().n() } } export const materialized = Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(C, { n: () => 7 }), () => ({ ...resource }));

cases.name: published getter data annotation
cases.body: const slot: { value: number } = lib.resource;

cases.name: published getter prototype view
cases.body: const slot: lib.Resource = lib.resource;

cases.name: published getter constrained argument
cases.body: function read<T extends { value: number }>(value: T) { return value.value } function main() { return read(lib.resource) }

cases.name: published prototype getter data annotation
cases.body: const slot: { value: number } = new lib.Resource();

cases.name: published getter typeof view
cases.body: const slot: typeof lib.resource = lib.resource; export function main() { return Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(lib.C, { n: () => 7 }), () => slot.value) }

cases.name: published getter mapped view
cases.body: const slot: Pick<typeof lib.resource, 'value'> = lib.resource; export function main() { return Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(lib.C, { n: () => 7 }), () => slot.value) }

cases.name: published spread is data
cases.body: const slot: { value: number } = lib.materialized; export function main() { return slot.value }
